blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Information about Earth's interior is classified into Direct and Indirect sources.
The Earth's radius is approximately 6,371 km.
Direct evidence covers less than 1% of the Earth's interior.
Seismic wave analysis is the most critical method for gaining information about the interior.
Direct evidence provides information for less than 1% of Earth's interior due to its immense radius of 6,371 km.
Seismic wave analysis is frequently tested as the single most important method for understanding Earth's interior.
